svg.desc: light-blue rounded Teacher HuBERT box above a pink rounded Student HuBERT box, each followed by a column of small squares (dashed light-blue for the teacher, solid pink for the student) split by dashed group lines, a purple Mean Pool box, small blue group tokens A B C on the teacher side and A A B B B C C on the student side joined by thin curved lines, and a purple MSE Loss box beside the student squares | source: iclr25-0207_fig1 (iclr25-0207_fig1_p2_mixed.svg) | candidate wave3:teacher-student-group-distillation-pooled-tokens-curved-matches | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
